title: Dewalt DCD794D1 20V MAX ATOMIC COMPACT SERIES Brushless Lithium-Ion 1/2 in. Cordless Drill Driver Kit (2 Ah)

reviews.reviewTitle: A compact, lightweight drill with impressive torque
reviews.reviewDescription: The DeWalt DCD794D1 was purchased to complement my larger DeWalt DCD996 while staying on the DeWalt 20V MAX battery platform, replacing an older 12V drill. Despite weighing only 1.5 kg, it’s lighter than the previous 12V model yet delivers double the torque (70 Nm). Although compact, the drill is surprisingly powerful. It features two speed settings, allowing very slow rotation for delicate or hobby work and higher speed with strong torque for tougher tasks. The 20V motor provides excellent performance and battery life. A notable improvement is the relocated LED light. Instead of being under the chuck (which caused shadows), it’s now positioned above the battery at the base, illuminating the drilling area much more effectively. Summary: A compact, lightweight drill with impressive torque, good battery life, improved lighting, and comfortable ergonomics—making it ideal for small jobs and precise drilling. Overall rating: 10/10.

reviews.reviewTitle: Powerful, lightweight, and no hand fatigue
reviews.reviewDescription: I've had an older B&D model for about 30 years. Now that I'M older, it's too clunky/heavy for my hands. This model is perfect, lighter and has more power. Looooove it. But after you order another battery and charger, you will be hard pressed to fit it all into the provided 'satchel.' I got a Carhart bag to store it all in. But I'm super happy with this purchase. No hand fatigue at all.

This unit is smaller than you might be used to but it has all the power of the larger ones. The smaller size makes getting in those tight areas so much easier. Guys that have borrowed it had great things to say about it. My son has practically hijacked it, LOL.

reviews.reviewTitle: Excellent drill for small jobs and small places.
reviews.reviewDescription: As a Dewalt fan, I am happy to report that this Atomic 1/2-inch drill is a winner all around. Its size is deceiving because it delivers an impressive level of torque for such a small package. It has two settings for rotation speed, which allows changing from a VERY slow spin rate (nice for sensitive surfaces and hobby projects) to a fast and hi-torque rate, much like my larger Dewalt cordless. The 20V motor provides great torque and great battery life. A super upgrade in these new models is the change in location of the helpful. illuminating light (it's under the bit chuck on my older model, which leaves the drill bit tip in shadow). Now, the light is just above the battery in the base, which allows bright illumination directly around the drill bit and surface being drilled. Overall, this drill is a "10" - small but more than powerful enough for small jobs, with a great ergonomic design that's nicely balanced, easy to hold, great at illuminating and easily controlled for delicate drilling. Happy drilling!
